description_full: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation, through its subsidiary, provides retail and wholesale electric services in the state of Arizona. The company engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity using nuclear, gas, oil, coal, and solar generating facilities. Its transmission facilities include overhead lines and underground lines; and distribution facilities consist of overhead lines and underground primary cables. The company also owns and maintains substations, including transmission and distribution yards; and owns energy storage facilities. Pinnacle West Capital Corporation was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona.

financial_summary: Pinnacle West Capital Corporati is a large-cap utilities business with a $13.0B market cap on $5.3B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +7% over the past three years and +4% annually across the full decade, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at 5% against a 6% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.
The company is burning through $820M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 5.2× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 2.5× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 3.3% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.
